record.original_question: Let V be a complex vector bundle over an algebraic manifold, and suppose the Chern classes of V are of Hodge type (k,k). Determine whether V can be given a holomorphic structure after adding or subtracting holomorphic vector bundles in the sense of K-theory.

evidence.quote: Given a complex vector bundle V over an algebraic manifold whose Chern classes are of type (k,k), will V admit a holomorphic structure if we add or substract from it holomorphic bundles in the sense of K-theory

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth complex projective algebraic manifold, and let $V \to X$ be a complex vector bundle (in the topological sense). Recall that the integral cohomology $H^{2k}(X,\mathbb{Z})$ maps into $H^{2k}(X,\mathbb{C})$, which carries the Hodge decomposition $H^{2k}(X,\mathbb{C})=\bigoplus_{p+q=2k} H^{p,q}(X)$; an integral class is said to be of Hodge type $(k,k)$ if its image in $H^{2k}(X,\mathbb{C})$ lies in $H^{k,k}(X)$. Let $K^{\mathrm{top}}(X)$ denote the topological complex K-theory of $X$, generated by isomorphism classes of complex vector bundles modulo $[E\oplus F]=[E]+[F]$, and let $K^{\mathrm{hol}}(X)$ denote the analogous Grothendieck group generated by holomorphic vector bundles on $X$, with natural map $K^{\mathrm{hol}}(X)\to K^{\mathrm{top}}(X)$.

Suppose that for every $k\ge 1$ the $k$-th Chern class $c_k(V)\in H^{2k}(X,\mathbb{Z})$ is of Hodge type $(k,k)$. Determine whether there must exist holomorphic vector bundles $W_1, W_2$ on $X$ such that $[V]+[W_1]=[W_2]$ in $K^{\mathrm{top}}(X)$; equivalently, whether the class $[V]\in K^{\mathrm{top}}(X)$ lies in the image of $K^{\mathrm{hol}}(X)\to K^{\mathrm{top}}(X)$.
artifact.category_tag: Hodge theory and holomorphic vector bundles
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a well-known problem connecting the Hodge conjecture to K-theory: whether every topological complex vector bundle whose Chern classes are Hodge classes is, stably in K-theory, holomorphic. It is closely tied to the (rational/integral) Hodge conjecture and to results showing that Chern classes of coherent sheaves on Kähler manifolds need not be combinations of analytic cycle classes. No general resolution appears in the literature; the problem is generally regarded as open.

status_evidence.title: The Hodge Conjecture (Deligne)
status_evidence.snippet: Hodge classes are conjecturally rational combinations of classes of algebraic cycles; Chern classes of holomorphic/coherent sheaves give such classes.
status_evidence.claim: The relationship between Hodge classes and holomorphic/algebraic structures remains a central open problem.

status_evidence.title: Hodge theory and the topology of compact Kähler and complex projective manifolds (Voisin)
status_evidence.snippet: Chern classes of coherent sheaves on compact Kähler manifolds cannot in general be expressed as rational combinations of analytic cycle classes.
status_evidence.claim: Realizing Hodge classes via holomorphic bundles/sheaves remains subtle and largely open.
